verses.1: To be destroyed by the songs of David’s lamentations.
verses.2: In my prayers, O God of righteousness, you have provided me with shelter in this vast wilderness. Hear my pleas.
verses.3: Children of man, what is my honor in all your love? You seek it in vain, like a fool.
verses.4: And know that when Jehovah falls, He will hear those who call upon Him.
verses.5: Do not sin or commit any wrongdoing. Say this in your hearts, while you are lying in bed. And remember these words.
verses.6: Worship the righteous gods and trust in Jehovah.
verses.7: Many say, “Who will protect us from harm? May your light shine upon us, O LORD.”
verses.8: You have given me joy in my heart from the time they were first born and grew up.
verses.9: In peace, together we will rest. May you, O LORD, be alone, so that I can rest in your presence safely.
